description: A fully disclosed, honestly published comparison of countries for near-retirees deciding where to retire abroad, scored on cost of living, visas, healthcare, and tax.
image_alt: Institute of Retirement — compare countries for retiring abroad.

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our team rigorously analyzes cost of living, visa options, healthcare, and tax implications for retiring abroad.

editorial.how_we_test: We source cost of living data from Numbeo, verify visa requirements with official consulates, assess healthcare via WHO rankings and local expat experiences, and model tax treatment based on current bilateral tax treaties.
editorial.how_we_make_money: We monetize via transparent affiliate links and lead generation for trusted services like international movers or specialized tax advisors. We never alter scores based on affiliate relationships.
editorial.corrections: We correct factual errors promptly and log significant updates at the bottom of affected pages.
